answer: A concrete approach: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The grove of work and the timber of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a lantern to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
